outputs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent 2.5D auto-chess unit sprite, one-star blue-flame Phoenix.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target (the existing project Phoenix sprite); Image 2 is only supporting historical color reference (use the blue/cyan ONE-STAR thumbnail at the bottom left; do not copy its interface).
Primary request: create a blue-flame color variant of the SAME Phoenix. Change its orange/red flight feathers, crest and tail to rich azure and indigo with luminous cyan/ice-blue flame tips. Keep the existing bird identity, beak, fully spread wings, long curling tail, three-quarter facing-right pose, feather structure and restrained gold armor ornament. Keep a small jade chest jewel. Match the original polished illustrated 3D game-unit rendering and fine feather details. The silhouette must remain unmistakably the same bird, readable when small.
Composition: one whole bird only, fully contained, centered in a landscape canvas with transparent margin around all wing and tail tips; no clipped feathers. Similar scale and camera to the edit target.
Background: actual alpha transparency with clean edges; retain semi-transparent blue flame tips only close to feathers. No broad glow cloud, no black/white/checkerboard background, no floor, no pedestal or shadow plate.
Constraints: no extra birds, no text, no stars, no border, no UI, no watermark. Do not redesign the anatomy or add weapons.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent 2.5D auto-chess unit sprite, three-star gold-flame Phoenix.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target (existing project Phoenix sprite); Image 2 is supporting historical palette reference only (the GOLD three-star thumbnail at the bottom left; no interface copying).
Primary request: make a GOLD-FLAME star-evolved color variant of the SAME Phoenix. Recolor the white and orange/red feathers to layered rich sun-gold, amber-gold and pale ivory-gold with yellow-white flame tips. The whole bird should read as golden, clearly different from the red/orange source and the blue one-star form. Keep the same identity, beak, fully spread wings, long curling tail, three-quarter facing-right pose, ornate but restrained gold armor and small jade chest jewel. Preserve the same polished illustrated 3D game rendering, feather anatomy and silhouette.
Composition: one whole bird only. Scale the bird slightly down inside the canvas so EVERY wingtip, crest and tail tip has at least a small transparent margin; no part of the silhouette may touch the canvas border. Landscape composition, fully contained and centered.
Background: actual alpha transparency, clean edges; semi-transparent golden flame tips close to the feathers. No broad aura cloud, no black/white/checkerboard background, no pedestal, floor, cast-shadow plate or background objects.
Constraints: no extra birds, no text, stars, frame, UI or watermark. Do not add weapons, change pose or redesign anatomy.

review: 两张原生图和战场实际渲染均已目视。主体羽翼、冠饰、玉石和卷尾保持项目识别，配色以客户端一星蓝、二星红、三星金缩略图为参考；不是原版模型提取。蓝图两个角的alpha为1/255，零alpha像素与半透明边缘如实记录，没有通过后处理改写。两图是有透明留白的原生输出；蓝图上方个别火焰尖端接近边界，不宣称像素级完全复刻。
